visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: What happened behind closed doors during one fateful week in custody to shatter a family and ignite a nationwide legal reckoning?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Arrested for a minor infraction in Italy, Stefano Cucchi is taken into custody, sparking a devastating week of detention that erupts into one of the country's most fiercely contested real-life court cases.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Heavy, somber, and demanding full emotional focus, this Italian legal drama offers a thoughtful, unsparing solitary watch.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Alessio Cremonini delivers a rigorous, deeply human biographical drama that confronts institutional controversy through an intimate family tragedy.
